jobs.title: Staff Product Marketing Manager - Data Security
jobs.description:
About Us

Proofpoint is a global leader in human- and agent-centric cybersecurity. We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. Over 80 of the Fortune 100, 10,000 large enterprises, and millions of smaller organizations trust Proofpoint to stop threats, prevent data loss, and build resilience across their people and AI workflows. Our mission is simple safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people.

How We Work

At Proofpoint you’ll be part of a global team that breaks barriers to redefine cybersecurity guided by our BRAVE core values

Bold in how we dream and innovate

Responsive to feedback, challenges and opportunities

Accountable for results and best in class outcomes

Visionary in future focused problem-solving

Exceptional in execution and impact

The Role

Proofpoint seeks a strategic and innovative Staff Product Marketing Manager to join the Data Security Product Marketing team, supporting a broad portfolio spanning Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), Insider Threat Management (ITM), and data security for AI. In this high-impact role, you will be the subject matter expert and market voice for how organizations protect sensitive data wherever people work, communicate, and collaborate. You will shape the narrative for helping customers prevent data loss, reduce insider risk, support compliance, and enable secure productivity across endpoints, email, SaaS applications, and cloud environments. You’ll work cross-functionally with product management, sales, strategic partners, and marketing to deliver differentiated positioning, impactful Go-to-Market (GTM) strategies, and sales enablement.

Your Day to Day

Develop strategic positioning and messaging for Proofpoint’s data security portfolio, including DLP, DSPM, ITM, and data security for AI, anchored in customer needs around data protection, compliance, and secure productivity. Own GTM strategy and launch planning for new data security capabilities, partnering with product, sales, channel, and demand teams to drive awareness, pipeline, and adoption. Create high-impact content across solution briefs, web pages, presentations, webinars, demo scripts, blogs, and customer-facing materials. Build sales and partner enablement, including playbooks, battlecards, objection handling, discovery questions, competitive guidance, and talk tracks. Track market, buyer, and competitive trends across DLP, insider risk, cloud data security, and adjacent data protection categories. Serve as a data security subject matter expert in sales trainings, customer briefings, field events, analyst conversations, webinars, and executive presentations. Partner with product and field teams to translate customer insights, use cases, and adoption patterns into sharper messaging, stronger launches, and more effective GTM. 

What you bring to the team

12+ years in product marketing for cybersecurity, data security, DLP, DSPM, insider risk, email security, endpoint security, cloud security, or related enterprise software. Strong understanding of data security use cases across DLP, DSPM, ITM, endpoint, email, cloud, SaaS applications, AI tools, data classification, policy management, compliance, and incident response. Proven ability to translate complex technical capabilities into clear, customer-centric messaging for security, risk, compliance, IT, and executive audiences. Experience leading GTM strategy, launches, sales enablement, and campaign planning for enterprise security solutions. Strong market and competitive analysis skills, with the ability to turn insights into positioning, sales guidance, and product feedback. Excellent communication and presentation skills across executive briefings, analyst conversations, webinars, customer meetings, and industry events. Collaborative, analytical, and execution-focused, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive measurable business impact. A bachelor’s degree is required; a technical concentration or MBA is a plus. 

Why Proofpoint?

At Proofpoint, we believe that an exceptional career experience includes a comprehensive compensation and benefits package. Here are just a few reasons you’ll love working with us

Competitive compensationComprehensive benefitsCareer success on your termsFlexible work environmentAnnual wellness and community outreach daysAlways on recognition for your contributionsGlobal collaboration and networking opportunities

Our Culture 

Our culture is rooted in values that inspire belonging, empower purpose and drive success-every day, for everyone.

We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you need accommodation during the application or interview process, please reach out to accessibility@proofpoint.com.

How To Apply

Interested? Submit your application along with any supporting information- we can’t wait to hear from you!

Consistent with Proofpoint values and applicable law, we provide the following information to promote pay transparency and equity. Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several U.S. geographic markets, and we pay differently based on those defined markets as set out below. Pay within these ranges varies and depends on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The actual offer will be based on the individual candidate. The range provided may represent a candidate range and may not reflect the full range for an individual tenured employee. This role may be eligible for variable compensation and/or equity. We offer a competitive benefits package, including flexible time off, a comprehensive well-being program with two paid Wellbeing Days and two paid Volunteer Days per year, plus a three-week Work from Anywhere option.

Base Pay Ranges 

SF Bay Area, New York City Metro Area

Base Pay Range 187,700.00 - 275,275.00

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
About the Role
Bedsure is looking for an Influencer Operations Specialist to grow and manage creator partnerships for our U.S.
TikTok business.
You’ll own relationships with assigned creators from initial outreach and negotiation through product seeding, campaign execution, and repeat collaborations.
You’ll also lead U.S.-based influencer events and provide local support for select evening livestreams.
- Working closely with teams in the U.S. and China, you’ll keep communication moving across time zones and help turn creator partnerships into lasting relationships.
This role will focus on the Bedsure brand.
What You’ll Do
Manage creator partnerships
* Serve as the day-to-day contact for assigned creators, managing outreach, negotiations, partnership terms, product seeding, and campaign execution.
* Build ongoing relationships and turn one-time campaigns into repeat partnerships.
* Track creator preferences, partnership history, and important follow-up details to support strong relationships and smooth team handoffs.
* Respond to routine creator requests within 24 hours.
Lead U.S. influencer events
* Plan and run influencer events in the U.S., including creator invitations, schedules, venues, vendors, materials, budgets, and on-site coordination.
* Work with internal teams to bring creators into events and manage the creator experience on site.
* Handle event-day issues and follow up with priority attendees about future collaborations within two weeks.
* Document event processes and help build repeatable operating procedures.
Support livestreams
* Attend and monitor livestreams for priority creators, especially first-time partners.
* Help resolve real-time issues involving the run of show, products, links, or audience engagement.
* Share a brief recap after each livestream, including creator feedback and follow-up items.
Coordinate across U.S. and China teams
* Keep internal teams informed about creator activity, event progress, and potential risks.
* Clearly communicate campaign requirements, content guidelines, and schedules to creators.
* Prepare a concise monthly update on partnership progress, repeat collaborations, event outcomes, and creator risks.
Track results and improve processes
* Monitor partnership performance, including repeat collaboration rates, collaboration frequency, livestream support, and event follow-through.
* Use data to communicate progress and identify opportunities to improve creator operations.
* Help develop and improve influencer partnership and event processes.
What We’re Looking For
* 3+ years of experience in influencer operations, influencer partnerships, creator relations, talent management, or a related field.
* Hands-on experience managing U.S.-based creator partnerships.
* Examples of independently managing creator relationships and converting initial campaigns into repeat collaborations.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* Strong cross-cultural communication skills and ability to work effectively with teams across the U.S. and China.
* Experience planning and executing in-person events in the U.S., or an established network of U.S. creators or MCNs.
* Strong relationship-building, negotiation, organization, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work some evenings and weekends to support livestreams and events, and to travel as needed.
Preferred Qualifications
* Professional proficiency in Mandarin Chinese.
* Experience with TikTok or TikTok Shop, including livestream operations.
* Experience in home, home textiles, or lifestyle categories.
* Familiarity with creator management tools and TikTok Shop’s creator ecosystem.
* Proficiency with email, collaboration tools, spreadsheets, and presentation software.
Location
This role is based in the New York City area and requires the ability to commute to our New York office.

At Bedsure, we take pride in our commitment to fostering diversity in the workplace as an equal-opportunity employer.
We welcome talent from all backgrounds, including but not limited to race, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, nationality, religion, veteran status, political affiliation, and disability.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Retail Marketing & Consumer Activation
jobs.description:
Serving the needs of all families with young children, Carter’s Inc. is the largest North American apparel retailer exclusively for babies and young children, encompassing Carter’s, OshKosh B’gosh, Skip*Hop and Little Planet brands. Meaningful work, constant learning, genuine people, and a community guided by core values that promote inclusion and innovation is in everything we do. There are many reasons to build your career at Carter's. 

HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT: 

The Senior Manager, Retail Marketing & Activation Marketing is responsible for developing and leading the CRI strategy to drive store traffic, deepen customer engagement, and strengthen brand affinity through meaningful retail and consumer experiences, and community engagement initiatives. This leader will transform Carter’s stores into destinations by creating compelling reasons for families to visit beyond traditional shopping. Through the development of scalable experience programs, activations, and locally relevant events, this role will bring the brand to life in ways that foster connection, drives store traffic, customer acquisition, and generate measurable business impact.

jobs.title: Kona Ice is hiring: Social Media Manager in Florence
jobs.description:
Title: Social Media Manager
Location: Florence, KY (on-site/hybrid)
Employment Type: Full-Time (Salary)
Compensation: $72,000 - $80,000 annually (based on experience)
Job Summary:
We’re seeking a proactive, creative, detail-oriented Social Media Manager to oversee social media and eLead platform support for our three brands: Kona Ice, Travelin’ Tom’s Coffee, and Beverly Ann’s Cookie Truck.
This mid-level role combines content strategy, social media execution, community engagement, performance analysis, and digital platform management.
The ideal candidate can manage multiple brands, collaborate with creative and marketing teams, troubleshoot technical issues, and stay current on evolving social media platforms and digital marketing tools.
Primary Responsibilities
Social Media Strategy & Content Management
* Develop and execute social media strategies aligned with each brand’s identity and business goals.
* Manage content calendars, plan campaigns, write copy, and coordinate the creation and publishing of engaging content across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.
* Maintain consistent brand voices while identifying relevant trends, platform updates, and opportunities to improve content performance.
Community Engagement & Brand Management
* Monitor and respond to comments, messages, and audience inquiries, aiming for a response within 24 hours.
* Maintain a positive brand presence and appropriately escalate sensitive customer concerns or reputational issues.
eLead & Digital Platform Management
* Manage assigned eLead Lite accounts and workflows, ensuring accuracy and consistency.
* Troubleshoot platform issues, account access, publishing errors, and other technical challenges, escalating when needed.
* Stay informed about platform updates, technical changes, and new features that may affect our brands or franchisees.
Analytics & Optimization
* Monitor social media performance, including reach, engagement, audience growth, and referral traffic.
* Provide regular performance insights and actionable recommendations to improve content and campaign effectiveness.
Cross-Functional & Franchisee Support
* Collaborate with the Kreative, Video, and Marketing teams to coordinate content production, deadlines, and campaigns.
* Assist franchisees with relevant social media and digital platform setup, access, troubleshooting, and education.
* Support marketing education at Roll Brands University and contribute to other brand and campaign initiatives as needed.
Process Improvement & Platform Knowledge
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve social media workflows
* Maintain accurate account access, platform configurations, and process documentation.
* Continuously develop knowledge of social media tools, digital marketing technology, and industry best practices.
What Success Looks Like in This Role
A successful Social Media Manager will do more than keep our social calendars full.
They will:
* Own the day-to-day social media presence for all three brands.
* Balance creative execution with performance analysis and strategic thinking.
* Keep accounts and assigned workflows accurate, functional, and organized.
* Stay ahead of relevant platform changes and help the team understand their implications.
* Identify and troubleshoot issues instead of waiting for someone else to flag them.
* Coordinate effectively with the Kreative, Video, and Marketing teams to keep production moving.
* Provide useful insights that help improve content and campaign performance.
* Deliver dependable support to franchisees and internal partners.
Additional Information:
* Standard working hours are Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM ET.
* Periodic travel to our Florence, KY headquarters is required for pre-planned meetings, company events, and other business initiatives.
Why Join Our Team?
We believe great marketing comes from talented people who are trusted to take ownership, think strategically, and continuously improve.
You'll join a collaborative, high-performing team where your work has a direct impact on business growth, franchisee success, and nationally recognized brands.
We work hard, support one another, and genuinely enjoy building something great together.

Continuously develop knowledge of social media tools, digital marketing technology, and industry best practices
